seoTitle: Williamson County Schools Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: Williamson County Schools starts Aug. 10, 2026, with a half day for grades 1–12. See 2026–27 breaks, early-release and late-start dates, plus the WCS PDF.
heroSummary:
Grades 1–12 start the 2026–27 WCS school year with a half day Monday, August 10, followed by their first full day August 11. Pre-K, Early Childhood and Kindergarten have their first full day August 17. The last student day is a half day Thursday, May 27, 2027. Fall Break is October 12–16, Thanksgiving Break is November 23–27, Winter Break runs December 21–January 4, and Spring Break is March 15–19.

WCS also schedules 11 early-release days for elementary schools and Hillsboro School and 27 late-start days for grades 6–12. Hillsboro students in grades 6–8 follow the early-release schedule instead.

customSections.label: What “No Students,” “No School” and “System Closed” Mean
customSections.content: WCS uses these labels to distinguish student attendance from staff and district operations. Students are out for all of Fall Break, October 12–16, although staff schedules differ during the week: October 12 is a conference flex day, October 13 is a district professional-development flex day, and WCS marks October 14–16 as System Closed.

customSections.label: WCS Inclement-Weather Plan
customSections.content: The Student School Calendar says WCS has stockpiled enough instructional time to cover up to 10 inclement-weather days without a makeup. If WCS misses more than 10 days because of inclement weather, the calendar lists the recommended makeup order as Mid-Winter Break, the second-semester professional-development day, Spring Holiday, Monday through Wednesday of Spring Break, and then additional days at the end of the school year. These are contingency options, not scheduled attendance dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Williamson County Schools start in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–12 begin with a half day Monday, August 10, 2026, and have their first full day August 11. Pre-K, Early Childhood and Kindergarten have their first full day August 17.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Williamson County Schools in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027, and WCS marks it as a half day. The graduation window runs May 27–30.

calendarFaqs.q: Who follows WCS early-release and late-start schedules?
calendarFaqs.a: Elementary schools and Hillsboro School have 11 published 113-minute early releases. Grades 6–12 have 27 published 45-minute late starts, except Hillsboro grades 6–8, which follow Hillsboro's early-release schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: Is November 18 the correct elementary early-release date?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The current WCS calendar says the November date changed from November 11 to November 18 and was approved August 17, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Does WCS have to make up the first 10 weather days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The calendar says up to 10 inclement-weather days are stockpiled and do not require makeup. Dates in the printed contingency order should not be treated as school days unless WCS activates them.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 22, 2026 against the current WCS Student School Calendar, Staff School Calendar, Late Start and Early Release Days, and Late Start and Early Release Information.
sourceReviewDetails: August 10, August 11, August 17, May 27, all published breaks, half days, the parent-teacher conference window and the 177-day total were checked against the official Student School Calendar.
All 11 elementary and Hillsboro early releases and all 27 grades 6–12 late starts were checked against the student and schedule PDFs; the November 18 amendment is preserved.
The Staff School Calendar was used only to explain staff activity during Fall Break, Election Day, Winter Break and Mid-Winter Break.
The WCS schedule guide was used to confirm the 113-minute and 45-minute changes, Hillsboro's exception, buses, supervision and SACC.
The weather sequence is reported as a contingency plan. Weather-contingency dates are not included in the ICS unless WCS activates them.
